notes: Two taḥwīl branches with different convergence points: the first ends at Wakee' («قالا حدثنا وكيع»), and the text writes no name after him; the second runs on from Muhammad b. Bashshar to Sufyan («قالوا حدثنا سفيان»), so no shared tail is written
The Companion Suwayd b. Qays relays the Prophet's words, so he is the last link of the second route
